# Development SDK artifacts

The active development artifacts below are built from the coordinated
`fix/vysotka-sdk-feedback` branches. They are prepared builds, not a claim of npm
publication. Runtime consumers provide the peer dependencies. Both are MIT licensed.

- `lo-ink-miniapp-sdk-0.20.0.tgz` — SHA-256 `bf524bacd4bb9727f5450b467b380f1d7828f2a11c35566566fe36ac40174b50`
- `lo-ink-bot-sdk-0.3.0.tgz` — SHA-256 `8cccbcfc26656ef80ba2089d9bb2eb269d711721ee9c3e773b8d808d1286bdc7`

Older archives are historical evidence and are not active development dependencies.
